exposure.needed: whether the environment still runs MirrorMaker 1; the evidence names neither the API kind/resource nor an image through which MirrorMaker 1 is deployed, so no static predicate can be built from it

original.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removes support for MirrorMaker 1, and users must migrate to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46 or newer.

decision.reason: [ev-87094cfdd770] and [ev-5d8b8b113b70] say only that MirrorMaker 1 support is removed and that users must migrate to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading. Neither excerpt names a custom resource kind, API group or version, image, Helm value or flag through which MirrorMaker 1 is deployed. Without that, no static predicate can be built from the evidence. An undecidable exposure with reason evidence-gap, which names what is missing (whether the environment still runs MirrorMaker 1), is the right condition and does not guess an identifier.
